name: Cloudcam
tagline: Browser video messages you can draw on and remix with effects while recording, published instantly.
problem: Social video tools give you a filter and a record button, not room to play.
solution: A single composited canvas records webcam, drawings and switchable effects with audio-reactive visuals, then uploads to Cloudinary for instant sharing and a gallery.
demo_moment: Team-described: doodle mid-recording, switch to an ASCII effect and share a link.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Everything runs in the browser with nothing to install.

lessons: A playful live demo can win a media-platform prize without any AI.
